purpose: Measure the original-STS KSP aerodynamic torque derivative matrix with respect to hypothetical body rates over a shadow-trace Mach/AoA/sideslip/bank envelope.

qualification.note: All cells are hypothetical Flight.simulate_aerodynamic_wrench_at results. Their reference kinematics come from an ENTRY_TRACE shadow prediction, not measured atmospheric flight.

provenance.hypotheticalPosition: The retained shadow trace's runway-relative along/cross coordinates are projected onto the configured KSC site and rotated by measured Kerbin body spin to the trace UT.
provenance.hypotheticalMach: Mach 4, Mach 5, the selected trace TAS divided by temperature-scaled local sound speed, and Mach 6. The sound-speed scale is calibrated from the nearest retained ENTRY_WITNESS KSP Mach record.
provenance.hypotheticalAngles: AoA 18/28 degrees, sideslip -5/0/+5 degrees, and KSP STS Flight.roll bank -40/0/+40 degrees.
provenance.hypotheticalRates: Zero plus independent +/-1 degree/second rotations around local body X, Y (roll), and Z (yaw); symmetric differences produce d(body torque)/d(body rate). These are not measured flight rates.
provenance.surfacePolicy: Use the loaded original STS and the currently neutral control surfaces. No control, throttle, RCS, SAS, action-group, save, position, velocity, orientation, UT, or physics setters are called.
provenance.flightPolicy: KSP remains paused; only instantaneous hypothetical wrench simulations are requested.

soundSpeedCalibration.note: Sound speed at each hypothetical altitude uses sqrt(gammaR * KSP temperature); gammaR is calibrated to the retained KSP Mach witness.

gridDefinition.derivativeMatrixOrientation: rows=body torque XYZ; columns=body angular velocity XYZ

loadedCheckpointAssessment.note: This is a paused read-only diagnostic sourced from the loaded named checkpoint. The live state is reported verbatim; no flight attempt is started.
